note: Tom, 2026-11-15: a toy has Current, a Shaded object (A) and an Isometric block (D). Isometric block is the one alt style for any new icon. The sheet (icons/sheet.html) shows those three.

cauldron.note: Tom picked A of spike cauldron-1 (2026-11-16), then A3 (Flick) of spike cauldron-2 for the fire, set into the pot: three tall tongues whose tips flick to the side, a hot core, warm light on the belly, an ember glow at the base. The black pot with a bright rolled rim, caramel soup marbled red and cream, a rubber duck afloat. Circling the pointer stirs the soup and the duck rides it; hover licks the fire and leans it away from the pointer, pops bubbles and lifts steam. The emblem is the pot, the grey soup, the duck and the fire.

iodine.note: Tom chose A of spike iodine-1 (2026-11-16), drawn before the toy exists: a lab beaker with a spout and three bold marks; at rest the ink stands halfway, blue-black below a sharp front, clear above. Hover pours a second clear liquid in; the beaker clears, waits with nothing moving, then snaps to ink at once, and runs again. The pointer is the slider: high waits long, low snaps soon. The emblem is the beaker and the ink.

aquarium.note: Tom chose A of spike aquarium-1 (2026-11-16), drawn before the toy exists: a planted tank from the front with dark trim at the top and the foot, teal water with a bright surface, a sand bed, two clumps of bold plants and three bright fish (orange, blue, yellow). The pointer is food: the fish turn and rise to it, tails wagging, plants swaying. A quick sweep is a tap on the glass: they scatter. Leave, and they swim home. The emblem is the tank, the sand and the three fish.

calving.note: Tom chose A of spike calving-1 (2026-11-16), drawn before the toy exists: a glacier face of five blue-white slabs with snow-capped serac peaks and dark grooves, standing at the back of a dark pool of fjord water. The pointer picks a slab: a crack runs, it leans out, drops and sinks; spray goes up, a wave ring rolls across the pool and fresh blue ice shows; then it grows back. One slab calves at a time. The emblem is the five slabs over the pool.

bz.note: Tom chose A of spike bz-1 (2026-11-16), drawn before the toy exists: a glass petri dish from a little above on a soft glow of light, orange dye with blue fronts, a spiral pair on one side and a target of rings on the other. Hover runs the reaction: rings pulse out and the spiral winds. The pointer seeds new targets where it rests; each source owns its own cell, so fronts meet and die on clean lines. The emblem is the dish, the spiral pair and the target.

calmjar.note: Tom chose A of spike calmjar-1 (2026-11-16), drawn before the toy exists: a squat glass jar with a tin screw lid, full of violet liquid; glitter lies at the foot in three layers (big silver hexes, holo flakes, gold dust) and some dust and holo flakes hang in the liquid at rest. Stirring with the pointer lifts the glitter, the faster the higher; each flake tumbles and flashes. Leave, and it settles, big flakes first, dust last. The emblem is the jar, the lid and the three layers.

rainstick.note: Tom chose D of spike rainstick-1 (2026-11-16), drawn before the toy exists: a walnut plinth is the block with a rim on its top edges; a brass post rises from it and the glass tube with walnut caps rocks on the post like a seesaw, brass pins in two staggered rows, bright glass beads heaped at the low end. The pointer presses its end down: the tube tips, the beads trickle through the pins and each pin lights as a bead passes. The emblem is the plinth, the post and the tube.

observatory.note: Tom chose A of spike observatory-1 (2026-11-16), then icon 1 and emblem a of spike observatory-2 (2026-11-17). The icon: the dome from the front on its catwalk ring and stone drum, a warm lit door, a red-lit slit, the green beam from the slit top. The beam aims at the pointer at once; the dome turns slowly so the slit follows; the slit opens and the tube shows. The emblem: the dome, the slit, the beam, the ring, and the grey drum with its door.

deepvent.note: Tom chose A of spike vent-1 (2026-11-16), drawn before the toy exists: a black smoker, a craggy basalt chimney with two flanges and rust mineral bands, its mouth glowing hot, a dark soft plume. A blue lure light hangs beside it. The pointer is the lure: the light follows it and lights the face of the chimney it meets. Hover sets the plume rolling and a few flakes of marine snow sink. The emblem is the chimney, the plume and the lure.

spillway.note: Tom chose A of spike spillway-1 (2026-11-16), drawn before the toy exists: the dam wall from downstream, pale concrete with a curved crest and a crest road, narrowing into the gorge. Three gates let white sheets of water run down the face into a cloud of foam. At rest the gates run half open. The pointer over a gate opens it wide; its sheet thickens and races and the foam swells. Hover lifts mist off the plunge pool. The emblem is the wall, the gates, the sheets and the foam.

lanterns.note: Tom chose A of spike lanterns-1 (2026-11-16): one domed paper sky lantern, lit from inside, two soft panel seams, the mouth and flame at its foot, a warm halo, its reflection broken in four dashes below. No frame. The pointer is the wind: the lantern leans and drifts away from it and the reflection follows; hover lifts it and the flame flares. The emblem is the lantern and the reflection dashes. The menu icon is unchanged until Tom says yes to the menu edit.

wires.note: Tom chose A of spike wires-1 (2026-11-17), the only direction drawn: the toy's pole head at its tilt, a grey steel arm and a tan timber arm, three post insulators, a grey can, a black cable off the east insulator and a pair of red high-tops hung over it by the laces. Hover bobs the cable and swings the shoes. The emblem is the pole, the arms, the can, the cable and the shoes (stimming-na7m).

tornado.note: Tom chose A of spike tornado-3 (2026-11-17), after rounds 1 and 2: the twister as a live model, lit by the low gold sun from the left in the eerie green before the dark. A heavy wall cloud with a sunlit cumulus tower, a gold rim and a green belly; under it the funnel flares and narrows to a rope, helical strands winding round a bending core, gold on the sunlit side, slate on the far side. Free on the menu ground, a soft green glow behind, a backlit gold dust cloud at the foot. The pointer drags the foot and the rope bends after it; high in the tile it lifts the rope off the ground. Hover spins the strands faster down the rope, runs dashes up them, turns the cloud bands, raises orbiting grit and flickers lightning in the cloud; leave lets it settle and stop. The emblem is the cloud, the tower, the funnel and the dust. On the menu since 2026-11-17 (stimming-53po).

rupert.note: Tom chose A of spike rupert-2 (2026-11-17), after round 1: one clear glass drop with the true shape of a real drop, a round head, a long taper measured from a photo, and a tail that curls up and back. The toy's polariser shows the trapped stress as crisp fringes that follow the form and close up in the tail. The glass reads by its clear skin and dark edge line, the softbox light along its top, the light it gathers along its belly, the caustic on the ground and a faint mirror in the ground. No frame. On the head the pointer is the hammer: each tap sends a stress ring through the fringes and nothing breaks. On the tail the pliers snip: frost races up into the head, the drop bursts into chips, and a hot new drop drips in and cools as its fringes return. The gallery's press snip is left out on the menu, where a press opens the toy; holding the pointer on the tail snips it. The Lab runs the pointer from head to tail and back. The emblem is the drop and a grey pool under it. On the menu since 2026-11-17 (stimming-zy58).

carwash.note: Tom kept the Current menu icon (2026-11-17, retain old carwash logo for now) over rounds spike carwash-1 and carwash-2, and approved an intro emblem traced from it: shared/emblems/carwash.svg (stimming-zy58).

postcard.note: Tom chose A of spike postcard-2 (2026-11-17): the postcard itself, card 1 of the toy on its face, East 4th at dusk in the rain: the ochre gable house under a deep indigo sky, dark pines, the porch beam with its string of party bulbs, the glowing red door, the warm window with the cat, the blue attic window, the wooden pole and its wires, the lit neighbours, the wet road holding every light as a streak. The lower right corner folds up to show the card's back. Free on the menu ground at a slight tilt. Enter: rain falls, the bulbs chase, the windows warm and the road shimmers; the card lifts and tilts after the pointer under a gloss sheen. Leave lets it settle and stop. The Lab tilts the card from side to side. The emblem is the card, the house, the pole and the folded corner. On the menu since 2026-11-17 (stimming-zy58).

snow.note: Tom chose A of spike snow-1 (2026-11-17): the snow globe as a live model, night glass violet above and blue below with a bold reflection; inside, a red cabin with a warm window between snow-capped pines on two drifts. The globe sits in a gold collar on a turned walnut foot. No frame. The pointer rocks it: the entry shakes it away from the pointer, a sideways move rocks it more, and a spring rights it. The snow lags the glass, swirls up and sinks; flakes that land fall again from the top. Leave lets the snow settle back to its picture and stop. The Lab rocks it from side to side. The emblem is the glass, the base, the pines and the cabin. On the menu since 2026-11-17 (stimming-zy58).

plasma.note: Tom chose A of spike plasma-1 (2026-11-17): the plasma globe as a live model, violet glass on a black lacquer base with two specular bands, the collar glowing violet from the ball. Seven filaments run from the white-hot core to the glass, each with a fork, pink at the root and blue at the tip, over a soft glow. No frame. Live, they wander and the glow flickers; the pointer pulls the nearest filament to it, thicker, with a bright spot on the glass, and its neighbours lean after it. Leave lets them settle and stop. The Lab takes a finger round the glass. The emblem is the ball, the base, four ropes and the core. On the menu since 2026-11-17 (stimming-zy58).

marble.note: Tom chose A of spike marble-1 (2026-11-17): the marbling tray as one glossy slab of navy enamel in a light perspective, deep enough to show its front wall, the cream size bath sunk in it, bands of the toy's four inks floating on the bath, and a walnut comb board on steel tines standing in the bath, the ink in front of each tine combed into a tongue. No frame. The pointer holds the comb: up and down drags it through the bath and each tine carries the ink at its tip, so new tongues trail behind it; side to side shifts the tines, and the comb shivers while it is held. Leave lets the ink settle back and stop. The Lab drags the comb back and forth. The emblem is the tray, the bath, the inks and the comb. On the menu since 2026-11-17 (stimming-zy58).

bowl.note: Tom chose A of spike bowl-1 (2026-11-17): one deep hammered bronze bowl seen from above at an angle, an engraved groove round the wall, dark water in it, and the wooden wand with its felt tip resting on the far rim. No frame. The pointer is the wand: it goes round the rim with the pointer, behind the bowl on the far half. A steady circle builds the voice, so the rim glows and rings run out over the water faster and brighter. Leave lets the bowl ring on, fade and stop. The Lab takes the wand round the rim. The gallery's press strike is left out on the menu, where a press opens the toy. The emblem is the bowl, the water, one ring and the wand. On the menu since 2026-11-17 (stimming-zy58).

subway.note: Tom chose A of spike subway-1 (2026-11-17): a stainless metro car seen three-quarter from the front, a big dark windscreen, the line's orange band round the body, two warm headlamps, and cabin windows lit warm along the side. No frame. The pointer leans the car into a bend toward it; on enter the headlamps flare, the car rocks on its springs and sodium tunnel lamps sweep along its side one after another. Leave lets the last lamp pass and the car settle and stop. The Lab swings the bend from side to side. The emblem is the car: front, roof, side, windows and headlamps. On the menu since 2026-11-17 (stimming-zy58).

washer.note: Tom chose A of spike washer-2 (2026-11-17): the toy's own floor as one round paver, free on the ground at a slant: warm herringbone brick under dark grime, moss bright in the joints, lit gold by the low evening sun, on a terracotta side. A clean, wet stripe runs across it to the jet: a glowing fan of water from the green nozzle of a steel lance with an orange grip, mist over it, mud running off downhill. Hover opens the jet; the pointer steers it and it cuts a new stripe through the grime, drops leaping off the fan. Leave shuts the jet; the grime grows back over the new stripe and the icon stops. With no pointer the jet sweeps the paver by itself. The emblem is the paver, the rest stripe, the fan and the lance. On the menu since 2026-11-17 (stimming-zy58).

washline.note: Tom chose A of spike washline-1 without the sun (2026-11-15): two worn posts with pulley wheels, a sagging line, a cream sheet, a blue shirt and a coral towel under the shared light, no frame. The washing leans away from the pointer and a quick stroke blows it like a gust. The emblem is the posts, the line and the three pieces.

spark.note: Tom installed A of spike spark-15 (2026-11-15) after fifteen rounds: the toy's signature image as a live miniature, no frame. A steel wheel throws a long-exposure fountain of sparks that skid and cool on a wet floor, mirrored below. Each spark is a real flight with drag, gravity and a bounce. Light runs along the flights on hover; the spray turns toward the pointer; a quick stroke spins the wheel. The emblem is the wheel, the spray and a grey reflection.

launch.note: Tom chose C of spike 34 (2026-11-09): Strata. The dawn as seven flat bands, night to gold, squeezed again in the water; one white hairline climbs through them to a glowing dot; five reeds in ink; grain. Hover climbs the line and warms the bands. The emblem is line work: six band edges that tighten toward the horizon, four water lines, a hairline and dot, two reed pairs. It replaces A of spike 33 (Ascent, dawn).

vortex.note: Tom chose F of spike 30 (2026-11-09): one frame of the toy in its own grain. A ring of smoke particles crosses the grainy green cone; particles in the cone turn green. Pointer x flies the ring; the tube rolls. The emblem is F3, a halftone of the frame.

window.note: Current is direction A of spike 20 made minimal: a moulded cabin window with a dusk view, the wing and a plain shade. Left and right lean; up and down pull the shade; a flick flexes the wing; the wingtip strobes. Tom went back to it from spike window-3 A (2026-11-09) and raked the winglet aft.

trainride.note: Tom picked A of spike trainride-1 over the round 2 variations on B (2026-11-10): Window by day. The cream cabin wall, a deep rounded reveal, the backlit cross bar; through it the sky, a cloud, the far shore with a village, the lake and the near meadow. On hover a catenary mast sweeps past and the lake glints drift.

lava.note: Tom picked direction A of spike lava-1 (2026-11-09): The lamp. The whole lamp as the toy shows it: brushed cone and cap, red liquid, amber wax, the molten layer, a soft glow behind. On hover the wax rises and sinks; the blob under the pointer swells.

ink.note: Current is direction F: a bloom traced from a frame of the toy, cut into four density bands in a square tile; the pointer looks into it and stirs the bands. The emblem is the tile and the bands as luminance steps.

oilslick.note: Current is direction B of the fresh round: a fingerprint pressed into a tile of oil film; the ridges cut through to the dark; the whorl core follows the pointer. The emblem is the tile with the ridges cut out.

foil.note: Current is direction A: a scrunched sheet of tilted facets on a hard shadow; the light turns and each facet flashes. The emblem is the lit facets in white.

trails.note: Current is direction A: five trails spiral round the pole in a lit porthole; the emblem is a heavy ring, four trails, the pole and a solid hill.

glass.note: Current is the shaded pane redo with an organic fracture (Fracture 2).

rain.note: Tom restored the old dusk tile (2026-11-09): drops now run down the pane with wet tracks, not sideways streaks. Macro, the bokeh redraw and spike 35 A to C were all rejected.

tvtree.note: Current is the neat redraw: three crooks, three sets. D, the block tree, stays on the sheet for a future implementation.

putty.note: The new A, the tin. Installed in the menu.

windmap.note: Tom chose A2 of spike windmap-2 (2026-11-09): a gloss globe in the main-shelf style, with silk strands, one warm storm and the pole axis. No plate, no hard shadow. The pointer drags the storm; it winds up and the strands flow. The emblem is the same globe, slimmed.

frietkot.note: Tom chose C1 of spike frietkot-4 (2026-11-09): a red and white striped paper cone, the fries seated deep and fanned out, a wooden fork. No sauce, no steam, no hard shadow. The pointer turns and tips it; hover lifts it into a slow float and sway. The emblem is the same cone.

fireworks.note: Tom chose A of spike fireworks-2 (2026-11-09): one peony bloom as a sphere of comet stars, tails fading in from the dark and burning white at the head, drooping under gravity. The pointer turns the sphere; hover fires it again in the next colours, with glitter.

motorway.note: Tom chose A of spike motorway-1 (2026-11-09): Brussels from overhead, the ring and its spokes from the toy's own map, in sodium on a night tile with grain. On hover the lamps die, then strike again in a ripple out from the centre: neon pink, salmon, sodium.

dijkstra.note: Tom chose A of spike dijkstra-2 (2026-11-09): a neat seven by seven street grid on a night tile, two merged blocks and a fast avenue. Light flows out along every street with a soft tip; the path draws on to the junction nearest the pointer and the rest recedes.

sonar.note: Current is direction A without the ear notch: a porthole on the live Listen waterfall; new rows hear the bearing under the pointer. The emblem is a heavy ring round a ship line, its harmonic and a whale glide. D (the 3D waterfall) stays for later.

jellyfish.note: Tom, 2026-11-23: "keep current" after round jellyfish-2. Current is A of spike jellyfish-1: a moon jelly in a blue glow, a pale bell with four gonad rings, a short fringe and four frilled arms; hover makes it pulse and rise. The emblem stays jellyfish-a.svg. Round 2 (the amber sea nettle, and the water block with the starfield) stays on the sheet.
